Version_Description: Config file version - please do not edit this value

Wind.StableTimeMin_Description: Minimum time (seconds) the wind stays constant
Wind.StableTimeMax_Description: Maximum time (seconds) the wind stays constant
Wind.ChangeTimeMin_Description: Minimum time (seconds) for gradual wind direction changes
Wind.ChangeTimeMax_Description: Maximum time (seconds) for gradual wind direction changes

Clouds.StableTimeMin_Description: Minimum time (seconds) clouds stay in direction (when SyncType=2)
Clouds.StableTimeMax_Description: Maximum time (seconds) clouds stay in same direction (when SyncType=2)
Clouds.ChangeTimeMin_Description: Minimum time (seconds) for cloud direction changes (when SyncType=2)
Clouds.ChangeTimeMax_Description: Maximum time (seconds) for cloud direction changes (when SyncType=2)
